abilities.critical_success: The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the gas for 1 hour, though if the creature has already been stupefied by the trap, that condition remains for its normal duration.
abilities.effect: Gas fills the chamber. Creatures within the chamber must succeed on a DC 30 Fortitude save or become stupefied 1 (stupefied 2 on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: The creature becomes stupefied 1 for 24 hours. If the target is already stupefied, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of stupefied 4) and the target takes 8d6 mental damage.
abilities.name: Gas Release

traits.name: Inhaled
traits.text: An inhaled poison is activated by unleashing it from its container. Once unleashed, the poison creates a cloud filling a 10-foot cube lasting for 1 minute or until a strong wind dissipates the cloud. Every creature entering this cloud is exposed to the poison and must attempt a saving throw against it; a creature aware of the poison before entering the cloud can use a single action to hold its breath and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the saving throw for 1 round.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Poison
traits.text: An effect with this trait delivers a poison or deals poison damage. An item with this trait is poisonous and might cause an affliction.

abilities.trigger: Both secret doors are closed and at least one creature is in the room

abilities.name: Critical Effect
abilities.text: As failure, except the target takes double the mental damage.

hazard.description: Seven nozzles hidden within holes in the 15‑foot-high ceiling release a poison gas.
hazard.disable: DC 33 Thievery (master) to disable the hidden mechanism on the north wall, immediately sucking the gas from the room, or DC 29 Thievery (expert) to adequately plug one of the seven nozzles. When all seven nozzles are plugged or destroyed, the trap is deactivated.
hazard.name: Befuddling Gas Trap
hazard.reset: After an hour, the trap deactivates; the gas disperses slowly, and the doors can be opened again. After 24 hours, the gas builds up and the trap can be triggered again.
hazard.routine: (1 action) The gas intensifies. Each creature in the room must make a DC 30 Fortitude save.
